model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", uses a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.9. The plot shows that coverage increases with the number of completions for all four models. The Llama-3B model (blue circles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.43 and rises to about 0.87. The Llama-3B + FT model (green triangles) begins at a slightly lower coverage of about 0.41 and increases to a final coverage of approximately 0.89. The Llama-1B model (light blue circles) starts at a coverage of around 0.38 and reaches a maximum of about 0.85. The Llama-1B + FT model (light green triangles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.37 and ends at a coverage of about 0.86. In all cases, the coverage increases steadily as the number of completions increases.
